string-array.item: Why offer a discount? Shops with a discount appear in the Deals tab, which shoppers open to look for offers.
Free advertising for your shop: a discount badge shows on the map and on its page, and every user sees it.
Dalilacom card holders look for shops that give a discount, so you win more customers.
A clear discount makes the customer choose you over the shop next door.
You are in control: the discount for the whole shop or for chosen products, how long, and how many times.
When a customer shows their card code, you see their discount and confirm it in seconds.
A small discount today, regular customers tomorrow.
